query: SELECT o.data, o.created_at::text AS "time!" FROM orders o JOIN carts c ON c.id=o.cart_id AND c.tenant=o.tenant WHERE o.tenant=$1 AND ($3::text IS NULL OR o.id=$3) AND (o.data->'orderCustomer'->>'customerId')=$2 AND ($4::text IS NULL OR (o.created_at,o.id)<(SELECT created_at,id FROM orders WHERE tenant=$1 AND id=$4)) ORDER BY o.created_at DESC,o.id DESC LIMIT 101
